blind.description: A low, stylized wooden bench or table with four thick legs and lower bracing stretchers, displaying an assortment of medieval tools or torture implements on its surface. The items include a coiled hemp rope, a small rectangular hammer or mallet, a fabric tool pouch/roll filled with small implements (picks, chisel, pliers), two metal-headed cylindrical rods/spikes with wrapped green handles, and a large pair of iron pincers/tongs. The wood has a warm brown painted grain, metal parts are matte charcoal iron, handles have olive-green wraps, and the tool roll is dark maroon cloth.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden plank top showing tool layout: on the left side, a coiled rope and a maroon rectangular tool roll with various small implements; angled near the center, a small square-headed hammer; along the center-right, two parallel rod-like spikes; and on the far right, a large pair of open-ended iron pliers or extraction pincers.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.8 feet tall (knee-height, about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 3.5 feet wide by 2 feet deep.
